findings.name: Civilization Monoculture Collapse
findings.observation: Left to run autonomously, the civilization collapsed to explore=0.9643 across all 10154 agents. Reason fell to 0.0096 — essentially dead. Create to 0.0053. A single drive consumed the entire motivational space of the civilization.
findings.implication: Without diversity pressure or protected drives at the civilization level, selection pressure produces monoculture. A civilization of pure explorers produces nothing, protects nothing, connects with nothing.
findings.build_impact: Civilization drive intervention applied. Target distribution set. Periodic rebalancing needed to prevent monoculture recurrence.
